plugins.name: all-mods
plugins.description: Install all 11 Claude Code mods. Includes optional self-drive, MCP controls, side chat and session tools.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

plugins.name: changes
plugins.description: /changes: the session's edits grouped by concept, then files, then the exact code; point at lines and ask Claude about them or have it change them

plugins.name: find-sess
plugins.description: /find-sess <what you remember>: find a past session in this repo with a Haiku call, then resume it

plugins.name: goal-meter
plugins.description: Live overall-goal progress bar above the prompt, from the task tools plus Claude's per-turn goal estimate

plugins.name: insight-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of the decisions, root causes and gotchas worth knowing, fed into ~/learning notes

plugins.name: live-progress
plugins.description: Live progress bands above the prompt for long-running work Claude starts: tests, builds, scripts, logs

plugins.name: lumen
plugins.description: Colourful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies, with animated diagrams, timelines, state machines and sparklines. A fork of prismantis.

plugins.name: mcp-control
plugins.description: Lets Claude see every configured MCP server, ask you (one click) to enable one that is off here, and reconnect a server after editing it

plugins.name: self-drive
plugins.description: /self-drive: hand Claude a task and walk away; it decides alone, logs every call it would have asked you, holds risky actions, and keeps going

plugins.name: session-namer
plugins.description: Gives each session a short findable name on exit, and re-checks it on later exits

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: /skills: per-prompt skill suggestions, what Claude actually loaded, and one-key use of a suggested skill

plugins.name: starter-kit
plugins.description: Start with richer replies, session insights, concept-based code review and progress bands.

metadata.description: 11 Claude Code mods for richer replies, living insights, code review, progress and workflow tools.
